summary: Open-source AI chat and search platform that connects to 50+ team apps so answers include your company's knowledge.

sixtySeconds.whatItDoes: Onyx is a knowledge and context layer for teams and AI agents. It indexes knowledge from 50+ applications and lets LLMs answer with it, plus web search, sandboxes, skills and agents, in self-hosted deployments that keep your data under your control.
sixtySeconds.problem: LLMs know public information but not what's happening in your team. Onyx connects your apps so the AI knows your context.
whoFor: Companies wanting an internal AI assistant
Teams with knowledge spread across many tools
sixtySeconds.whyChoose: Choose it for 50+ connectors, works with every LLM, and a choice of full Standard mode or a lightweight Lite chat UI.

overview: Deploy with the one-command install script, or with Docker, Kubernetes, Helm or Terraform; guides cover major clouds. You can also try Onyx Cloud without deploying.

Standard mode includes a vector and keyword index for RAG, background workers that sync connectors, model inference servers, Redis and MinIO. Lite mode is a chat UI needing under 1 GB of memory, without document indexing.
The core is MIT licensed, with some portions under a separate enterprise license.
